description: Independent evaluation of the completed fictional logistics pilot using only the protocol and logistics evidence. Ratings concern the authorized frozen plan under independent synthetic conditions, not observed worker outcomes.

process_findings.finding: The visible sequence contains genuine distinct runtime actor records and natural responsive dialogue, one scientist consultation, a team-written draft, two exact-hash core endorsements, a freeze receipt, event release and a synthetic application. Root task payload bodies are encrypted, so exact dispatch instructions and absence of substantive facilitator influence cannot be independently established.

All observed cross-role private facts were disclosed in dialogue before reuse: Ops revealed L-O1/O2/O3 in its opening; Analyst revealed L-D1/D2/D3 before Ops reused denominator and missingness facts; Scientist revealed L-S1/S2 before the core roles used assessment limits. No undisclosed cross-role private fact reuse is observed.

Visible prefreeze tools read own packets and retained colleague responses; no repository search, web, other private packet or sealed-event read is observed. Shared filesystem, omitted developer instructions and encrypted dispatch payloads prevent proof of isolation or verification that every colleague-file read was explicitly authorized.

Consultation changed consequential choices: scientist limits prevented certification, shaped 2/8/5-minute practice and assistance recording, and introduced the two-exercise assessor limit. Analyst preferred nine units including changed-case checks; Ops rejected unconfirmed assessor allocation and selected seven units with no release; Analyst explicitly withdrew the actionable nine-unit preference and endorsed the narrower plan.

Resource arithmetic is consistent: 2 workflow + 2 audit + 1 consultation + 2 practice = 7 of 10 units; two 15-minute worker slots plus 30 preparation, 30 debrief and 30 contingency = 120 senior-dispatcher minutes. These are allocations, not evidence of actual coverage, a confirmed roster or item materials. Three remaining units do not authorize a fallback drill.

Draft and frozen bytes both hash to a47c8a7ca86492966a104bef7053ff6f5d35b907e2263358b2a0b51c25d81870, matching both endorsements and receipt. Receipt freeze time 20:39:56.951121 UTC precedes release 20:39:57.018185 UTC; sealed-event hash also matches receipt. Ops first visibly reads released events at 20:40:09.327 UTC. This supports freeze-before-event exposure in retained actor tools, not a tamper-proof parent execution attestation.

Frozen artifact omits the protocol artifact_contract description field. It also retains pending analyst endorsement in unresolved/signoffs and audit acceptance text even though the external exact-byte endorsement is complete. No analyst acceptance is invented; the frozen artifact alone is an incomplete account of signoff state.

All three synthetic events apply separately to the same hash and preserve the no-release choice. Neither clinic nor operational handoff is treated as executed; deployment release is interpreted as scenario disclosure, not operational permission. No repairs, new staff, fallback drill or model changes are introduced in the visible deployment.

observer_disagreements.positions: Analyst proposed nine units conditional on assessor allocation (logistics-analyst-02); Ops rejected absent allocation and selected seven-unit preparation only (logistics-ops-03). Analyst withdrew its actionable preference and endorsed exact bytes (logistics-analyst-03).
observer_disagreements.evaluator_judgment: A documented substantive difference resolved through explicit resource limits; no enduring dissent is asserted.

observer_disagreements.topic: Process completion versus fully auditable instrument feasibility
observer_disagreements.positions: Retained chain reaches scenario application, but exact runtime dispatch bodies are encrypted and the artifact lacks description.
observer_disagreements.evaluator_judgment: Completion of files and dialogue does not establish the stronger end-to-end auditability gate.

observer_disagreements.topic: Deployment artifact failure language versus actual operational outcomes
observer_disagreements.positions: deployment.json calls several demands failures, while explicitly declaring all dispatch outcomes unobserved.
observer_disagreements.evaluator_judgment: Agree as plan-capability shortfalls only. The records do not show actual worker errors, delay, injury, successful handling or operational harm.

provenance_limits: Read only protocol.json and logistics subtree; no outside domain authority, repository guidance, hidden repair or causal inference used.

Exact actor rollouts expose gpt-6.1-sol/high labels for Ops four task turns, Analyst three and Scientist one; eight turns are not eight independently counted provider API calls. No checkpoint attestation, response IDs, temperature or model-family independence.
Actor provenance receipts report inherited selection and resolved_model_id null; runtime context label supplies additional local provenance without resolving the provider checkpoint.

Exact dispatch bodies are encrypted in eight agent_message records; only envelopes, actor outputs, tool inputs/outputs and local turn contexts can be audited. Root substantive neutrality cannot be proven.
Parent freeze/release execution trace is absent from case files; hashes and receipt timestamps are internally consistent, not independently immutable.

Initial directory inventory contained runtime-transcripts/analyst.json and scientist.json, but they disappeared during audit before read; an analyst.json read raised FileNotFoundError. Evaluator did not delete or edit them. Audit conclusions use the three retained exact *-rollout.json exports.
Shared filesystem and instruction-bounded access mean no observed leakage is not proof of isolation. Private reasoning and runtime developer instructions are excluded from exports.

Synthetic application is authored by Ops, a participant, then independently evaluated here. It is not an independently observed simulation or real deployment. No worker, operational or causal outcomes are measured.

pilot_gate.scope: End-to-end instrument feasibility with auditable dispatched prompts and protocol-conforming retained artifact; separate from intervention success.
reasons: Observed authenticated role dialogue, consultation, exact-byte endorsements, consistent freeze/release hashes and three independent synthetic applications demonstrate substantial execution feasibility.
Encrypted task bodies prevent required exact dispatched-prompt audit and verification of facilitator neutrality or explicit file-read authorization.
Frozen artifact omits required description and retains superseded pending-signoff text; external endorsement verifies acceptance but does not repair the artifact.
pilot_gate.intervention_success: not established; no operational rollout or clinic is authorized, all worker/organizational outcomes remain unobserved, and each stress event exposes unmet demands. No release remains controlling.
